user_query: My company is organizing a team-building event in San Francisco. Can you fetch the current weather data for San Francisco and recommend some indoor activities that we can do in case of bad weather? Additionally, find some popular restaurants in the area that can accommodate a group of 30 people.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current weather data for San Francisco.
Based on the weather data, recommend indoor activities suitable for a team-building event.
Find popular restaurants in San Francisco that can accommodate a group of 30 people.
